Needs changes before merge. One blocking finding.

The axial span checks keep the reported opposite holes separate. The existing machine and mixed-list refusals pass.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P2] Keep floor detection independent of floor triangulation — `crates/motion/src/drilling/mouth.rs:31`.** The triangle that the ray hits must also have two vertices on the bore rim. A valid floor can have interior vertices. Its ray-hit triangle then fails this condition, although the floor still closes the bore.

   I reproduced this through the built public `recognize` and `recognize_cross` functions. Start with this PR's `opposite_blind_block` fixture. Split each floor triangle at Z = ±17 into three triangles about its centroid. Preserve the winding and the boundary edges. This keeps the same closed solid and hole dimensions.

   The original fixture returns one downward hole and one upward directed hole. The subdivided fixture returns two downward holes and no directed holes. The lower hole has these incorrect values:

   ```text
   entry_z: -17.0
   floor_z: -25.0
   through: true
   ```

   Its actual mouth remains at Z = -25. Its blind floor remains at Z = -17. Detection therefore loses the mouth and direction that this PR must preserve. It also bypasses the directed-hole refusal path. This check does not establish that an unsafe post passes later safety checks.

   Identify the connected floor without requiring the ray-hit triangle itself to contain a rim edge. Keep the protection against unrelated crossing faces. Add a regression with subdivided floors. Check both Z and radial orientations.

Local validation used the trial merge with upstream/main `8f32e8df3a263d6a6f4f0801d1f334373c5a4190`. The merge had no conflicts.

- Motion drilling unit tests: 47 passed.
- Motion `cross_invariance`: 2 passed.
- App `drilling_cross`: 9 passed.
- App `drilling_detect_opposite`: 1 passed.
- App `bore_core`: 5 passed.
- App `drill_undersize`: 3 passed.
- App `golden_cl`: 33 passed.
- App `setup_align_hole_kinds`: 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Additional public-library check with subdivided floors: failed as described above. The original fixture passed.

I independently repeated two claimed mutations in temporary copies of the recognition modules. The driver used the PR's block fixture and the built geometry and CL dependencies. Restoring upstream's old `merge_z` failed the Z pin. Restoring upstream's old `merge_found` failed the radial pin. Each restored fix passed again. The worktree source stayed unchanged.

No goldens moved. The PR changes no `.nc` or `.cl` file. No UI file changes need screenshots. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
